title: 第一千六百二十一章 巅峰对决二第一千六百二十章 巅峰对决一
content_zh:
鲲鹏妖帝与北冥仙帝的对峙不过瞬息之间，两股浩瀚无匹的气息碰撞的刹那，一场撼动天地的激战便轰然爆发。
原本还算平静的北冥海海面骤然掀起惊涛骇浪，亿万道水柱冲天而起，旋即汇聚成一道道高达万丈的水墙，遮天蔽日，如同一道横亘天地的水之壁垒。裹挟着毁天灭地的恐怖能量，以雷霆万钧之势向北冥仙岛碾压而来。
北冥仙帝立于北冥仙宫上空，帝袍在狂风中猎猎作响，他望着那道遮天蔽日的水墙，目光坚毅如钢。
只见他缓缓抬手，指尖凝聚起一道璀璨的仙光，口中沉声喝道：
“北冥玄冰，冻结四海！”
话音落下，仙光骤然扩散，整个北冥海的温度瞬间骤降，靠近仙岛的海水以肉眼可见的速度凝结成冰，一道贯穿天地的冰墙拔地而起，与那万丈水墙轰然相撞。
“轰隆——！”
巨响震彻九天，冰与水的碰撞产生无尽的能量冲击波，席卷整个海域。
无数低阶海妖在这股力量下瞬间化为齑粉，连大阵内的刘长旭等人都被这股余波震得气血翻涌，不得不全力运转仙力进行抵御。
天空中，鲲鹏妖帝巨大的身影遮天蔽日，不断发出惊天动地的嘶鸣，攻势愈发狂暴。
北冥仙帝周身大道法则流转，继续施法以冰墙进行抵抗。这场准帝强者之间的对决，才刚刚拉开序幕，却已让整个北冥海域陷入了前所未有的浩劫。
此刻的刘长旭，早已被两位准帝强者的恐怖手段所震撼得。他屏息凝神，双眸一眨不眨地捕捉两位准帝强者的身影：今天这场准帝强者的交锋，于他而言是千载难逢的观摩良机，那怕仅悟到一点皮毛，那也是天大的收获。
鲲鹏妖帝每一次摆尾，都引得整个北冥海为之剧烈翻涌，就连时间、空间都已然扭曲，仿佛它就是北冥海的化身。
北冥仙帝抬手间凝出的北冥玄冰，并非凡俗之冰，而是蕴含着至阴至寒的大道之力，甚至能冻结人的神魂。
两人施展的道术看似简单，却暗合天地至理，举手投足间便有毁天灭地之威，远非大罗、太乙修士所能企及。
而这两位准帝强者的每一个不起眼的举动都蕴含天地至理，让刘长旭为之着迷，悟透一个，都让他受益匪浅。
“原来如此……”
他喃喃自语，指尖下意识模仿着两人结印的姿势：
“大道至简，真正的强者，早已将神通仙术融入举手投足之间，无需刻意炫技，便有万钧之力。”
刘长旭不由想到：

而在这时，妻儿以及三千镇妖卫已然聚集在刘长旭身边。
黄玉蔷见丈夫神情专注的观看远处的战斗，非常识趣的没有上前打扰，立刻在他身周布下隔音禁制，免得影响他悟道。
谁都清楚，能亲眼目睹准帝强者之间的对决那是多么的危险幸运，如果真有所悟，他的修为实力必然进一步提升。
远处虚空的激战仍在继续，水与冰的碰撞、不断刷新着众人对“力量”的认知。
刘长旭望着那两道顶天立地的身影，眼中除了震撼，更多了几分向往与坚定：
这便是他未来要企及的高度，唯有站在巅峰，才能真正护住自己想护的一切。
而随着时间的推移，刘长旭惊骇地发现，北冥仙帝在与鲲鹏妖帝的交锋中竟渐渐落入下风。
这个发现让刘长旭心头焦灼如焚。他不敢深想：一旦北冥仙帝落败，护岛大阵失去支撑而崩碎，那头对自己恨之入骨的大罗雪熊必然会第一时间扑上来，到那时，别说自己，恐怕连带着妻儿与麾下修士都要沦为对方的泄愤之物。他只能攥紧拳头，在心中一遍遍祈祷北冥仙帝能稳住阵脚。
不过，这份惶恐并未持续太久，久经生死考验的刘长旭，很强迫自己冷静下来：
即便北冥仙帝一时落于下风，有护岛大阵作为依托，至少能抵挡一阵。
更何况，能统御北冥仙域亿万年的准帝，怎会没有后手底牌？即便真到危急关头，向其他仙域求援亦是必然，绝不会轻易被鲲鹏妖帝击溃。
想通了这一点，刘长旭重新稳住心神，目光再次投向远处天际的那场激烈对决，这一次，他的目光中满是坚毅与沉静。
随着持续不断的观摩领悟，刘长旭对时间、空间、五行本源法则的感悟，在如遇春雨般疯长，空间本源法则首先圆满，紧接着，火、木、水、时间、土、金等本源法则领悟也相继圆满。
而在这时，刘长旭的气质也在悄无声息中发生了质的变化，周身开始萦绕起丝丝缕缕的大道气息。
他竟在面临生死危机的巨大压力下，通过观摩准帝强者的战斗，成功触摸到了大道法则的门槛。
不过，此时的刘长旭并没有得意忘形，反而更加专注地捕捉着两位准帝强者交手时的法则轨迹。
他知道，这样的机缘，可不是那么好得到的，他必须牢牢抓住这个机会，尽可能高的提升自己对大道法则的感悟，这样才能提升自己和家人的生存几率。
远处天际，北冥仙帝与鲲鹏妖帝的巅峰对决仍在持续。
鲲鹏妖帝巨尾一甩，便掀起遮天蔽日的巨浪，那浪涛裹挟着亿万吨海水，化作无数道蕴含着大道法则的水龙，咆哮着撕裂长空，尽显毁天灭地之威。
北冥仙帝则抬手凝出无尽玄冰，冰晶如流星骤雨般漫天洒落，触之即冻结一切，转瞬便将亿万里虚空化作冰封国度，连光线都被冻凝在半空，寒意直透神魂。

二者交锋产生的能量余波，如涟漪般层层扩散，即便远隔亿万里之遥，护岛大阵内的修士们仍觉神魂被无形巨手攥紧，气血翻涌不止。
刘长旭立于虚空，双眸凝视远处天际，心神完全沉浸在感悟大道法则之上。
他周身萦绕着淡淡的法则光晕，时而有细微的时空涟漪在身侧流转，时而有金木水火土五行灵光交替闪现
显然，他正将观战所得融入自身法则感悟，让圆满的本源法则与初窥门径的大道法则相互交融。

content_en:
The confrontation between Kunpeng Demon Emperor and Beiming Immortal Emperor lasted only a moment. The moment the two vast and unparalleled auras collided, a fierce battle that shook the world broke out.
The originally calm Bei Ming Sea suddenly stirred up turbulent waves. Billions of water columns rose into the sky, and soon gathered into water walls tens of thousands of feet high, blocking out the sky and the sun, like a water barrier spanning the sky and the earth. Carrying the terrifying energy that destroyed the heaven and earth, it rolled towards Beimingxian Island with thunderous momentum.
The Beiming Immortal Emperor stood in the sky above the Beiming Immortal Palace, his emperor's robes rustling in the strong wind. He looked at the wall of water that blocked the sky and the sun, his eyes as firm as steel.
He slowly raised his hand, a bright fairy light condensed on his fingertips, and shouted in a deep voice:
"Beiming Xuanbing freezes the whole world!"
As soon as the words fell, the fairy light suddenly spread, and the temperature of the entire North Underworld Sea dropped suddenly. The seawater near the fairy island condensed into ice at a speed visible to the naked eye. An ice wall that penetrated the sky and the earth rose from the ground and collided with the ten thousand feet of water wall.
“Boom—!”
A loud noise shook the sky, and the collision of ice and water produced endless energy shock waves that swept across the entire sea area.
Countless low-level sea monsters were instantly turned into powder by this force. Even Liu Changxu and others in the formation were shocked by the aftermath, and their blood surged, and they had to use all their immortal power to resist.
In the sky, the huge figure of Kunpeng Demon Emperor blocked the sky and the sun, and kept making earth-shattering screams, and the offensive became more and more violent.
Immortal Emperor Beiming's body was flowing with the laws of the avenue, and he continued to cast spells to resist with an ice wall. This showdown between the quasi-emperors has just begun, but it has already plunged the entire Beiming Sea into an unprecedented catastrophe.
At this moment, Liu Changxu had already been shocked by the terrifying methods of the two powerful quasi-emperors. He held his breath and concentrated, his eyes catching the figures of the two quasi-emperors without blinking: Today's confrontation between the quasi-emperors was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for him to observe and learn. Even if he only understood a little bit, it would be a huge gain.
Every time Kunpeng Demon Emperor swung its tail, it caused the entire Bei Ming Sea to surge violently, and even time and space were distorted, as if it was the incarnation of the Bei Ming Sea.
The Beiming Xuanbing that condensed when the Beiming Immortal Emperor raised his hand was not ordinary ice, but contained the power of the great path from extreme cold to cold, and could even freeze a person's soul.
The Taoist skills performed by the two people may seem simple, but they coincide with the principles of heaven and earth. Their movements can destroy the heaven and the earth, which is far beyond the reach of Daluo and Taiyi monks.
Every inconspicuous move of these two powerful quasi-emperors contains the truth of heaven and earth, which fascinated Liu Changxu. Understanding each one of them has benefited him a lot.
"That's it..."
He murmured to himself, his fingertips subconsciously imitating the postures of the two people forming seals:
"The most simple way of doing things, the truly strong ones have already integrated magical powers into their movements. They don't need to show off their skills deliberately, but they have tremendous power."
Liu Changxu couldn't help but think:
At this moment, his wife, children and three thousand demon-suppressing guards had gathered around Liu Changxu.
Huang Yuqiang saw her husband watching the battle in the distance intently, so she was very sensible and did not come forward to disturb him. She immediately placed a soundproof ban around him so as not to affect his enlightenment.
Everyone knows how dangerous and lucky it is to witness the duel between powerful quasi-emperors. If he really realizes it, his cultivation strength will definitely be further improved.
The fierce battle in the void in the distance continues, and the collision of water and ice constantly refreshes everyone's understanding of "power".
Liu Changxu looked at the two figures standing tall, his eyes not only shocked, but also full of yearning and determination:
This is the height he will reach in the future. Only by standing at the top can he truly protect everything he wants to protect.
As time went by, Liu Changxu was horrified to discover that Immortal Emperor Beiming was gradually losing ground in the confrontation with Demon Emperor Kunpeng.
This discovery made Liu Changxu anxious. He did not dare to think deeply: Once the Beiming Immortal Emperor was defeated, the island protection formation would lose its support.If it bursts into pieces, the big snow bear that hates him will definitely pounce on him immediately. At that time, not to mention himself, I am afraid that his wife, children and monks under his command will all become the target of the other party's anger. He could only clench his fists and pray over and over again in his heart that Immortal Emperor Beiming could stabilize his position.
However, this panic did not last long. Liu Changxu, who had experienced the test of life and death, forced himself to calm down:
Even if Immortal Emperor Beiming is at a disadvantage for a while, with the support of the island protection formation, he can at least withstand it for a while.
What's more, how could a quasi-emperor who can rule the Beiming Immortal Realm for hundreds of millions of years not have a trump card? Even if it really comes to a critical moment, it is inevitable to ask for help from other immortal realms, and it will never be easily defeated by Kunpeng Demon Emperor.
After figuring this out, Liu Changxu regained his composure and turned his eyes to the fierce duel in the distance again. This time, his eyes were full of perseverance and calmness.
With continuous observation and understanding, Liu Changxu's understanding of the original laws of time, space, and the five elements grew like a spring rain. The original laws of space were first perfected, and then, the understanding of the original laws of fire, wood, water, time, earth, metal, etc. were also completed one after another.
At this time, Liu Changxu's temperament also underwent a qualitative change quietly, and the aura of the avenue began to linger around him.
Under the tremendous pressure of a life-and-death crisis, he successfully touched the threshold of the Great Law by observing the battles of powerful quasi-emperors.
However, Liu Changxu did not get carried away at this time. Instead, he focused more on capturing the trajectory of the two powerful quasi-emperors as they fought.
He knows that such an opportunity is not easy to come by. He must firmly seize this opportunity and improve his understanding of the laws of the great road as high as possible, so as to improve the survival probability of himself and his family.
In the distant sky, the peak showdown between Beiming Immortal Emperor and Kunpeng Demon Emperor is still going on.
Kunpeng Demon Emperor swung his huge tail, setting off a huge wave that covered the sky and the sun. The waves carried hundreds of millions of tons of sea water and turned into countless water dragons that contained the laws of the great road. They roared and tore into the sky, showing the power of destroying the heaven and the earth.
Immortal Emperor Beiming raised his hand to condense endless black ice. The ice crystals fell all over the sky like meteor showers, freezing everything upon contact. In an instant, hundreds of millions of miles of void were turned into a frozen country. Even the light was frozen in the air, and the chill penetrated the soul.
The energy aftermath generated by the confrontation between the two spread like ripples. Even though they were hundreds of millions of miles away, the monks in the island protection formation still felt that their souls were being grasped tightly by invisible giant hands, and their energy and blood were surging.
Liu Changxu stood in the void, staring at the distant sky, his mind completely immersed in comprehending the laws of the great road.
There is a faint halo of law lingering around him, and sometimes there are subtle ripples of time and space flowing around him, and sometimes the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth flash alternately.
Obviously, he is integrating what he gained from watching the battle into his own understanding of the law, allowing the perfect original law and the first glimpse of the great law to blend with each other.
